summary: Tested all 4 CRs (265-268) on Batch BE for mygenie.online. CR-265, CR-266, CR-267, CR-268 all verified as working except for the form submission flow where the backend /api/demo-request returns {saved: false}, preventing OTP stage from showing.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 200 but body is {saved: false} when submitting from DemoBottomSheet with test data (name='QA Test', phone='9999999999', email='qa@test.com'). Frontend code checks `if (res.data?.saved === false)` and shows error toast, staying on form stage. OTP screen never appears.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All CR-265, CR-266, CR-267, CR-268 frontend implementations verified working. Only failing test is full form submission flow — /api/demo-request returns {saved: false}. All 5 Alpha LP pages have correct <a> CTAs. Consent banner gone everywhere. DataLayer events fire correctly. StickyMobileCta at bottom-0 with no extra offset.
rca_of_issue: Form submission fails because POST /api/demo-request returns HTTP 200 with body {saved: false}. The frontend DemoBottomSheet correctly handles this by showing a toast error and NOT advancing to OTP stage. Root cause is in the backend — either the antiBot leadQuality() signals from a Playwright-driven browser are too low, or there's a MongoDB write failure. The antiBot useAntiBot() hook generates signals based on browser behavior; automated tests may not generate sufficient interaction signals. Reproduction: open sheet, fill form with name=QA Test/phone=9999999999/email=qa@test.com, submit — API returns {saved: false}.
